purpose: One fresh, bounded Linux amd64 strict signed consumer proof for the exact shipping RCC 18.19.6 asset: offline strict trust verification, cold provider acquire, then providerless cached execution of native SQLite with a released process lease.

fixture.providerRootUse: Read-only serving of artifact CAS; run GET-only consumer commands, verify a full before/after tree hash, and stop if startup would create or mutate any fixture content. The provider root's required objects/sha256, manifests/sha256 and tmp directories already exist. Do not clone the 73 MB provider root under this cap.
fixture.paddedRootContract: One org-prod-2026 Ed25519 public key; padded standard Base64, 32 decoded bytes. Public test root only. Its original file stays unchanged. No key value or private signing key is copied into receipts.
fixture.privateSigningKey: Previously generated one-off fixture key was removed after artifact signing. No re-signing or key recovery is needed or allowed for this existing signed artifact.
fixture.fixtureScope: Previously signed v18.19.5 artifact is only a stable acceptance input; acceptance output is bound only to the 7945f956 shipping binary. This is not a new signature, publisher attestation, or cross-version release claim.
fixture.strictConsumerReceiptAvailability: No 727-labeled strict-consumer receipt/helper was found under the final-main-727 evidence. Reuse the existing provider-runtime signed input and previously proven strict-consumer invocation pattern; do not rebind the older 680f/097 proof as this result.

revocationPlan.freshSnapshot: Generate a new empty unsigned fixture snapshot at execution time with NewRevocationBundleAt(artifactDigest, nil, time.Now().UTC(), "fixture-refresh"); import/read it back using the helper through HTTP into a NEW tiny owned scratch provider root; copy only the validated bytes to the NEW owned filesystem trust-carrier copy. revocationPlan.signedStatus: Unsigned empty fixture freshness state; no signed/publisher revocation claim. It supplements the existing signed artifact signature and does not weaken strict-remote policy or sign/re-sign any artifact.

actions: Wait for parent root admission and for concurrent compile/measurement jobs to be idle.
Require workspace free space >= 3061592064 bytes initially or >= 2684354560 bytes after reserving the exact planned allocation; preserve a hard floor of 2.5 GiB free throughout.

Create only ownedRunRoot; copy the exact actual binary from actualBinarySourcePath to ownedRunRoot/rcc-linux64, then SHA-256 and stat it before any execution. Require hash/size/source metadata equal this plan.

Capture source commit/tree from immutable Git objects, actual binary before-hash, provider-root complete file/directory hash manifest, trust-carrier file hashes, and padded-roots hash. Do not modify or checkout source.
Copy trust-signed and trust-roots.json to ownedRunRoot/trust-carrier and ownedRunRoot/trust-roots.json, verifying every copied file against the original hashes.

Start the copied 7945 binary's cache serve only against ownedRunRoot/revocation-import-root on 127.0.0.1:0. Run the existing helper against that scratch URL to create a new timestamped empty snapshot, HTTP PUT it, and verify exact HTTP readback. Stop this scratch importer and require numeric exit 0 and closed port.

Copy the validated fresh-revocations.json bytes to ownedRunRoot/trust-carrier/sha256/0fd0a3dfd8348e06a1d68e21ce9c5bf8e6830d40a2b2c1e14737e8b27570e26e/revocations.json. Confirm signature/provenance/SBOM bytes remain byte-identical to the originals.

plannedCommands.commandTemplate: ROBOCORP_HOME=$OUT/offline-home RCC_HOLOTREE_MODE=private $BIN env trust verify --artifact sha256:0fd0a3dfd8348e06a1d68e21ce9c5bf8e6830d40a2b2c1e14737e8b27570e26e --platform linux_amd64 --builder rcc-holotree-v12 --provenance $OUT/trust-carrier/sha256/0fd0a3dfd8348e06a1d68e21ce9c5bf8e6830d40a2b2c1e14737e8b27570e26e/provenance.json --sbom $OUT/trust-carrier/sha256/0fd0a3dfd8348e06a1d68e21ce9c5bf8e6830d40a2b2c1e14737e8b27570e26e/sbom.json --signatures $OUT/trust-carrier/sha256/0fd0a3dfd8348e06a1d68e21ce9c5bf8e6830d40a2b2c1e14737e8b27570e26e/signature.json --revocations $OUT/fresh-revocations.json --trust-roots $OUT/trust-roots.json --strict-remote --json
plannedCommands.requiredReceipt: valid=true, code=valid, policyMode=strict-remote, artifactDigest exact, keyID=org-prod-2026, fresh revocation snapshot/fetchedAt present and no more than the unchanged default 24 hours old.

actions: Start copied 7945 binary cache serve against the EXISTING provider-runtime-1791665359/provider root on 127.0.0.1:0 with an owned server home. The consumer only performs GETs. Require the exact root tree to remain unchanged; any delta fails the no-mutation guard.

Run env acquire with --artifact sha256:0fd0a3dfd8348e06a1d68e21ce9c5bf8e6830d40a2b2c1e14737e8b27570e26e, --provider <ephemeral loopback URL>, --trust-carrier $OUT/trust-carrier --trust-carrier-type filesystem --trust-roots $OUT/trust-roots.json --strict-remote --json, under a new empty consumer-home.

Set RCC_NO_BUILD=1, CONDA_OFFLINE=true, MAMBA_OFFLINE=true, PIP_NO_INDEX=1, UV_NO_INDEX=1; set upper/lower HTTP(S)/ALL proxy variables to 127.0.0.1:1 and NO_PROXY/no_proxy to 127.0.0.1,localhost. This blocks package-index/build access while allowing only the loopback artifact provider.
plannedCommands.requiredReceipt: cacheHit=provider; compatible; strict-remote verification valid; exact artifact digest and same revocation snapshot as offline verify.

actions: Stop the artifact provider process, record numeric process exit 0, and prove its loopback port is closed before executing the consumer.

Run copied binary env exec with --artifact exact digest, local filesystem --trust-carrier $OUT/trust-carrier, --trust-carrier-type filesystem, --trust-roots $OUT/trust-roots.json, --strict-remote --json -- python -c 'import sqlite3; print("sqlite3", sqlite3.sqlite_version)' and intentionally OMIT --provider. Use the consumer-home from cold acquire and package-offline/proxy-blocked env.

Require cacheHit=local-materialization, valid strict-remote verification, status=completed, child exitCode=0, non-empty leaseId, SQLite version output, and no active lease JSON under artifacts/v1/materializations/<artifact-hex>/leases after process completion.

Independently compare provider/consumer manifest bytes; verify manifest declares the exact artifact digest and object-index digest; rehash all 5045 indexed objects against storedDigest and storedSize.
Rehash every file in consumer CAS (expected 5049 files) against its content-addressed path; require all hashes match and count equals live reference protection count.
Record ready state, exact artifact/materialization binding, live references with 5049 protected digests, persisted strict trust record and offline/online verification identity.

Rehash actual binary before/after, padded roots before/after, original signed trust carrier before/after, and original provider root before/after. Record exact numeric exits for all commands, server shutdown/port probes, per-command wall/CPU/RSS when /usr/bin/time supports it; timings are observations only and not performance claims.
Write one root-reviewable verifier JSON with CAS per-file hashes and a concise acceptance receipt; keep total raw receipts <= 2097152 bytes.

resourceBudget.sizingBasis: 311320180-byte exact consumer-home manifest recorded for the same 0fd0a3df artifact in prior preserved strict consumer evidence; 1414304-byte original trust-carrier tree; 65-byte public roots; 5 MiB service/snapshot reserve; 2 MiB raw receipt cap; 22392994-byte actual shipping binary. The provider CAS is read-only input and is not duplicated. Enforce the disk-floor guard before each copy/stage and abort before consumer acquire if actual usage exceeds cap.
resourceBudget.goCache: No Go compile or new Go cache is needed: use existing previously compiled 6357257-byte refresh helper without modifying it; 7945 source API blob identities listed above are byte-identical to helper's source lineage. If helper execution is rejected or unavailable, stop and seek root re-admission rather than compiling or expanding scope.

preserve: Small raw stdout/stderr, command metadata, numeric exit files, provider lifecycle/port-probe receipts, trust roots public key hash/size metadata (never key bytes in summary), trust attachment hash receipts, source/binary identity and per-object CAS hash manifest.
This plan and all root-review receipts under the plan namespace.
All original provider-runtime-1791665359 fixture files unchanged.
Root's temporary 324 source/N1 staging and original locations unchanged; root restores them after consumer cleanup and verifies them before handoff.
neverModifyOrDelete: any shared source worktree, other owned home, Go cache or Actions state
preservationAndCleanup.archivePolicy: Do not create an additional large home archive under this disk cap. After root verifies exact per-file hashes and public state, preserve the concise receipts and ask root before deleting only the owned new consumer/runtime directories.

claimsAndLimits: One actual v18.19.6 shipping Linux amd64 binary and one pre-signed v18.19.5 fixture artifact only.
The fresh empty revocation snapshot is an unsigned test fixture freshness input, not a signed revocation authority claim.

Does not prove macOS or Windows, broad ABI-family coverage, publisher key custody, publisher-signed revocation lifecycle, real Actions integration, general offline behavior for uncached content, performance improvements, release approval, or issue closure.
